Use the rotating-fluid equilibrium equation dP/dr = ρ r ω².
Convert 10,000 RPM to angular speed ω = 2π × (10,000 / 60) rad/s ≈ 1047.2 rad/s.
Leave fluid density ρ as a symbolic free parameter.
Leave the inner radius as a symbolic variable r₀.
Leave the boundary pressure P(r₀) as a symbolic parameter.
Integrate from r₀ to r to obtain P(r) = P(r₀) + ½ ρ ω² (r² − r₀²).
Do not use gravitational acceleration g in the centrifuge calculation.
